custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the rim's geometry. In real ceramics, rims are usually very regular unless intentionally rustic, but AI often generates 'wobbly' rims due to diffusion instability. Check if the waviness is consistent with a handmade artifact or a generation error. Also, inspect the handle for any signs of fusion with the body.
